content.title: Stock Market Today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq Close At New Highs On Cool CPI Data
content.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average and other major indexes posted healthy gains Friday after a lower-than-expected inflation report.  IBM soared 7.9% and helped lift the Dow, as well as chipmaker Advanced Micro Devices.  All three major indexes got a boost as the U.S. Consumer Price Index readout came in softer than expected, paving the way for more interest rate cuts.
